name: edges

tiers.bern: atlas service point with municipality FSO number 351 (atlas attribute fsoNumber) that is a stop point, or an operating point owning a boarding edge (stop_point=false)
tiers.ring: atlas stop point (or operating point owning a boarding edge) outside Bern whose coordinate is at most 5 km from the swisstopo municipal boundary of Bern
tiers.connected: any other station called at by a GTFS trip that serves at least one `bern` stop (fp2026 or fp2027)
